subject.title: WhatsApp pairing can stick at Logging in until gateway restart finalizes 515 recovery

question: Should this remain a separate WhatsApp 515/manual-restart recovery tracker while phone-code login PRs are reviewed, or should maintainers fold it into the canonical phone-code fallback issue?
rationale: The open PRs cover the phone-code entrypoint and partial credential cleanup, but this issue preserves a distinct observed finalization failure that those PRs have not proven away.

options.title: Keep Separate Until Proven
options.body: Keep this issue open and require live proof that the accepted phone-code implementation no longer needs a gateway restart during the 515 phase.

options.title: Fold Into Phone-Code Canonical
options.body: Treat the 515 sequence as acceptance criteria for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85867 and close this only after that canonical path explicitly carries the evidence.

options.title: Split A Recovery-Only Fix
options.body: Ask for a WhatsApp-owned PR that targets restart-free 515 recovery without expanding the generic channel-auth API.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Until Proven
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require live proof that the accepted phone-code implementation no longer needs a gateway restart during the 515 phase.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses public CLI, plugin SDK/auth contract, and WhatsApp session-state boundaries where recent history points to steipete as the strongest routing owner.
